articles.subject: Invoice 2026-0731 has the wrong reference
articles.body:
Hi,

Our finance department bounced invoice 2026-0731 because the reference says A. Lind and it must be our cost centre code NK-4412. Otherwise it cannot be routed in our e-invoicing system.

Could you issue a credit and a corrected invoice, and use NK-4412 from now on?

Best regards,
Anna Lind

articles.subject: Re: Invoice 2026-0731 has the wrong reference
articles.body:
Hi Anna,

Credit note and corrected invoice were sent this morning, and NK-4412 is now stored as the standing reference on your account so future invoices carry it automatically.

Best,
Mia Berg
